zig.build: zig build-exe -target wasm32-freestanding -fno-entry -OReleaseSmall -rdynamic --cache-dir {cache}/zig --dep solution -Mroot={root}/zig/shim.zig -Msolution={source} -femit-bin=main.wasm && { echo '/*'; cat {source}; echo '*/'; echo "const WASM = '$(base64 < main.wasm | tr -d '\n')'"; cat {root}/zig/run.js; } > submit.js
